referenceAuthority: CS-14 addendum B — wireframe is valid design reference
method: Pixel-only comparison. Wireframe 50% opacity over render. Aligned: canvas top-left (108,0), no stretch.
wireframeLimitation: Wireframe PNG is 1024×1022 and covers only the top 29.0% of the 3530px canvas. FAQ, Audit and Footer are not present in the reference crop.

visualMass.note: Render placeholders screenshot as near-white; band height 792px vs wireframe 314px

visualHierarchy.Header: NO MATCH — render header 14px taller; labels align at overlay top but baseline spacing differs
visualHierarchy.Hero image: NO MATCH — render yellow block extends 367px lower than wireframe block; dominates upper canvas
visualHierarchy.Hero content: NO MATCH — title/CTA row displaced +402px; CTA no longer sits directly under wireframe hero boundary
visualHierarchy.Social Proof: NO MATCH — strip displaced +426px; 24px taller than wireframe strip
visualHierarchy.Property Explorer: NO MATCH — section 478px taller; horizontal triptych proportions match (~50/15/35) but vertical envelope diverges
visualHierarchy.Priority Engine: NO MATCH — starts at Y 1748 vs wireframe Y 844 (+904px); card row sits far below wireframe priority block

rootCause: Vertical rhythm is redistributed toward the upper half because the hero image band consumes 640px of canvas height versus 287px in the wireframe (+353px), displacing every subsequent section boundary downward by 367–904px.

fixProposals.visualMismatch: Hero block is 2.23× taller in pixels than the wireframe block; overlay shows wireframe hero ending while render hero continues for hundreds of pixels.
fixProposals.whyVisually: The upper third of the canvas reads as one continuous light field instead of the wireframe's compact intro image followed immediately by title row.
fixProposals.recommendedCorrection: Reduce hero image visible height until wireframe overlay boundary at Y 345 aligns with render boundary (target ~287–320px canvas-relative, not 640px).

fixProposals.visualMismatch: Explorer band is 478px taller than wireframe; priority section appears only at bottom of wireframe but mid-page in render.
fixProposals.whyVisually: Gallery and floorplan read as a short module in wireframe; in render they float inside a tall white envelope with excess breathing room above and below placeholders.
fixProposals.recommendedCorrection: After hero correction, compress Property Explorer vertical envelope until explorer end aligns with wireframe Y 844 equivalent.

fixProposals.visualMismatch: Priority block starts 904px lower than wireframe.
fixProposals.whyVisually: Not an independent layout error — cumulative displacement from oversized sections above.
fixProposals.recommendedCorrection: Re-evaluate after hero and explorer height correction; do not tune Priority in isolation.
